title: Kosmesis components.lock.json
description: Per-project record, written by `kosmesis add` and `kosmesis update`, of each installed component's registry version and the hash of every file as installed. `kosmesis outdated` and `kosmesis update` use it to tell an available update from a local edit. Commit it.

components.description: Keyed by component address: "button" for the default registry, "@namespace/button" for a registry added with `kosmesis registry add`.

version.description: The registry item's version when it was installed or last updated. Absent when unknown: the registry doesn't version the item, or the component was installed before versioning.

registry.description: The registry base the component was installed from, recorded only for a `kosmesis add --registry <base>` override.

adopted.description: The files were already on disk when Kosmesis started tracking them, so their recorded hashes are what was found rather than what a registry served. `kosmesis update` treats such files as possibly edited.

files.description: Project-relative file path -> SHA-256 of its content as installed (line endings normalized to LF).
